The MPLAPACK (formerly known as MPACK) is a multiple-precision version of the widely-utilized LAPACK library (\url{https://www.netlib.org/lapack/}). Version 2.0.1 of MPLAPACK is based on LAPACK version 3.9.1 and was translated from Fortran 90 to C++ using the FABLE source-to-source conversion tool (\url{https://github.com/cctbx/cctbx_project/tree/master/fable/}). \item A complete rewrite of LAPACK and BLAS in C++ using FABLE and f2c.

GMP~\cite{Granlund12} is a C library for performing arbitrary precision arithmetic on signed integers, rational numbers, and floating-point numbers. It allows for calculations to any level of accuracy, as long as the machine's resources permit. GMP also comes with a C++ binding, and we use the {\tt mpf\_class} class as an arbitrary floating-point number. Additionally, we support complex numbers using the ${\tt mpc_class}$ class.

MPFR~\cite{10.1145/1236463.1236468}, a C library for multiple-precision floating-point computations with correct rounding based on GMP, is another option. Unlike GMP, MPFR does not come with a C++ binding, and we use the {\tt mpreal} library~\cite{mpreal} as an arbitrary floating-point number. We also support complex numbers using MPC~\cite{MPC}, a library for multiple-precision complex arithmetic with correct rounding, via the ${\tt mpcomplex}$ class (more precisely, the final LGPL version with
